title: TenantWideArchiveVolumeMeasuredPayload
description: Payload of the TenantWideArchiveVolumeMeasured platform event (class: platform; INV-REQ-878, INV-Q-14069 option A). evidence-svc emits it with the audit bytes of the tenant-wide entity of a tenant; it carries no entityRef. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

tenantRef.description: The tenant whose tenant-wide audit bytes were measured.

bytes.description: The retained archive volume of the tenant-wide audit bytes, in bytes.

measuredAt.description: The instant of the measurement; tenancy-svc keeps the latest per tenant.
